# AWS-03 CRC errors during storm weekend

During the November storm weekend, AWS-03 reported several short runs of CRC
errors on its radio transmissions. The errors coincided with heavy rain and
gusts, but the station resumed ordinary reporting without a field reset by
Monday morning.

## Observations

The collector received valid reports between the failed packets, and the
rain gauge continued to advance during the same period. Battery readings did
not show an obvious drop. The radio antenna and its mast bracket were still
upright at the follow-up visit, although wet vegetation had grown close to
the lower cable route.

## Follow-up

We cleared the vegetation, reseated the external connector, and left the
radio settings unchanged. Future E-RADIO-CRC messages at AWS-03 should be
compared with rainfall and wind conditions before replacing hardware. This
incident does not establish a general rain-gauge fault.
